description:
Welcome to Landers Electric! I'm Stephan, a C-10 Electrical Contractor with 20+ years of experience. This channel is for aspiring electricians, apprentices, and homeowners.

Get a raw, unfiltered look at installs through our POV series, including panel upgrades, recessed lighting, and service calls.

📚 Learn the NEC, conduit bending, wire pulling, and safety from a licensed contractor.
🎥 New videos weekly — subscribe to follow the journey.

About the Expert:
Stephan Landers is a C-10 Electrical Contractors License holder and founder of Landers Electrical Contracting Inc. He shares professional knowledge and provides quality electrical services in San Diego.
